claim.summary: Closure degree locality: over any field, for the functional pigeonhole system (Booleanity, hole and functionality axioms, pigeon axioms Q_i = 1 - sum_j x_ij, multilinear ring) with any number of pigeons and N holes, C_d the degree-d PC closure of all axioms, C_D cap V_d = C_d for d <= D <= ceil(N/2); in particular, for E of degree <= e and K + e <= d, {u in V_K : uE in C_D} = {u in V_K : uE in C_d}, so every kernel question sits at d = K + e. Proof: Proposition 2.8 and Theorem 2.9 (Impagliazzo-Pudlak-Sgall) at d and D, with B_d = B_D restricted to |a| <= d; the functional-transfer entry's degree fact (its case d = K) at a general d.
claim.assessment: Working proof passed by the sole fresh-context medium reviewer with corrections (the general form and the hypotheses' Theorem 2.9 at d).

claim.summary: Conjecture: over F_2, for the functional pigeonhole system with n+1 pigeons and n holes, at D <= ceil(n/2) and K+1 <= D, for every set F of linear errors, the common kernel of F in V_K modulo the degree-D closure C equals the largest, over choices of linear representatives E' = E modulo C cap V_1, of the common kernel modulo the closure H of the hole and functionality axioms, plus C cap V_K. By lem:closure-degree-locality it suffices to take D = K+1. The representative form is needed: x00 + Q_0 has C-kernel 15 but trivial-representative domain side 10 at 6x5. Evidence: check:dense-linear-kernels (one size, K=1).
claim.assessment: Conjecture; restated in the representative form after the sole fresh-context medium reviewer refuted the representative-free draft with x00 + Q_0; evidence one size over F_2.

claim.summary: Admissible numbering transfer: over any field, for the functional pigeonhole system (Booleanity, hole and functionality axioms, pigeon axioms Q_i = 1 - sum_j x_ij, multilinear ring) with any number m of pigeons and N >= 1 holes, D <= ceil(N/2), C the degree-D PC closure of all axioms and H that of the hole and functionality axioms alone: if a set F of monomial errors with K+|E|<=D has one numbering of pigeons and holes in which, for every matching E in F and every dance-admissible x_t in T_K cap B_K (Impagliazzo-Pudlak-Sgall basis) with t cup E a matching, x_{t cup E} is in B_D, then the common kernel of the x_E in V_K modulo C equals the common kernel modulo H plus C cap V_K. Equivalently the IPS projection R satisfies R(x_E r) = x_E r modulo H on its image.
claim.assessment: Working proof passed by the sole fresh-context medium reviewer in two follow-ups; the criterion is sufficient, not necessary, and needs the union of the errors' hole sets to miss a hole.

claim.summary: Spare-pigeon theorem: over any field of characteristic p > 0, onto weak PHP O_{m,N} (Booleanity, collisions, linear rows sum_j x_ij = 1, linear onto columns sum_i x_ij = 1, no functionality) with m = N (mod p) and N >= 3 has no PC refutation of degree <= ceil(N/2). Proof: the substitution x_{m,j} -> 1 - sum_{i<m} y_ij (a fat spare pigeon taking every free hole) maps a degree-D refutation to one of weak PHP^{m-1}_N of degree max(D,2), which has fewer axioms than the functional PHP of Impagliazzo-Pudlak-Sgall (ECCC TR97-042, Theorem 2.9: no refutation of degree <= ceil(N/2) over any field).
claim.assessment: Working proof (elementary reduction plus an imported theorem), after two fresh-context reviews.

claim.summary: Pigeonhole shattering, not thin (from Impagliazzo-Pudlak-Sgall 1999, Proposition 3.8 and Theorem 3.9, read with the proof of the first): for PHP with m > n >= 5 pigeons and holes (pigeon sums as linear axioms, hole and functionality products), D = ceil(n/2), over F_2: 1 is not in C_D; for j <= D the level of the closure is the number N_j of partial one-to-one maps of j pigeons with a pigeon dance, for every degree-compatible order, and N_j >= binom(m, j)(n-j)...(n-2j+1); a set of variables with all pairs standard has at most n <= 2D elements, against free dimension m(n-1); and N_j > (4/3)^j binom(X, j) for all j <= X <= 3n/2 and 1 <= j <= D-2, so the closure is not thin in any window. So at a degree below sqrt(v), outside the range D >= sqrt(v) of thm:thin-kernel-source-exclusion, a proper closure can shatter nothing beyond about 2K and still fail the thin count; whether that happens in range is open. Enumeration for n <= 9; compared with prop:pigeonhole-quotient-count in a few cases.
claim.assessment: Working proof from an imported theorem, its basis proposition read with proof; one reviewer; control by enumeration at n <= 9.
